genesis.2.p1.b1.text: Thus the heavens and the earth were completed in all their vast array.

genesis.2.p1.b2.text: And by the seventh day God had finished the work He had been doing; so on that day He rested from all His work.

genesis.2.p1.b3.text: Then God blessed the seventh day and sanctified it …

genesis.2.p2.b4.text: Now no shrub of the field had yet appeared on the earth … But springs welled up from the earth and watered the whole surface of the ground.

genesis.2.p2.b5.text: Then the LORD God formed man from the dust of the ground and breathed the breath of life into his nostrils, and the man became a living being.

genesis.2.p3.b6.text: And the LORD God planted a garden in Eden, in the east, where He placed the man He had formed.

genesis.2.p3.b7.text: Now a river flowed out of Eden to water the garden, and from there it branched into four headwaters:

genesis.2.p3.b8.text: where there is gold. And the gold of that land is pure …

genesis.2.p4.b9.text: Then the LORD God took the man and placed him in the Garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.

genesis.2.p4.b10.text: You may eat freely from every tree of the garden,

genesis.2.p4.b11.text: but you must not eat from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil; for in the day that you eat of it, you will surely die.”

genesis.2.p5.b12.text: It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make for him a suitable helper.

genesis.2.p5.b13.text: And whatever the man called each living creature, that was its name.

genesis.2.p5.b14.text: But for Adam no suitable helper was found.

genesis.2.p6.b15.text: So the LORD God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep, and while he slept …

genesis.2.p6.b16.text: And from the rib that the LORD God had taken from the man, He made a woman and brought her to him.

genesis.2.p7.b17.text: This is now bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh;

genesis.2.p7.b18.text: she shall be called ‘woman,’ for out of man she was taken.

genesis.2.p7.b19.text: And the man and his wife were both naked, and they were not ashamed.
